title: Refactor AgentBuilderAgent v1.1 for dependency injection (testability without monkeypatch)
summary:
Introduces a minimal DI (dependency injection) seam in AgentBuilderAgentV1_1 so integration-style tests can be written without monkeypatching module-level symbols.

What changes:
- Add AgentDeps dataclass holding callable dependencies for: parse_spec, normalize_spec, infer_steps_if_missing, generate_skeleton.
- AgentBuilderAgentV1_1 constructor accepts deps (optional). Defaults preserve current runtime behavior.
- Update integration tests to inject deterministic deps instead of monkeypatch.

Safety:
- Proposal-only behavior unchanged.
- No new tools or write effects.
- No changes to high-risk filtering.

files.content:
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Awaitable, Callable, Optional

from agents import Agent  # provided by openai-agents

from agent_builder_agent.core.errors import error_response
from agent_builder_agent.core.proposal_builder import build_pull_request_proposal
from agent_builder_agent.core.risk_detector import detect_high_risk
from agent_builder_agent.core.repo_reader import snapshot_from_existing_tree
from agent_builder_agent.core.diff_planner import derive_structure_hints
from agent_builder_agent.core.skeleton_generator import generate_skeleton as _generate_skeleton
from agent_builder_agent.core.skeleton_generator import infer_steps_if_missing as _infer_steps_if_missing
from agent_builder_agent.core.spec_parser import SpecParseError, normalize_spec as _normalize_spec, parse_spec as _parse_spec
from agent_builder_agent.core.validators import schema_validate_request_v0, schema_validate_proposal_v0
from agent_builder_agent.core.toolgate_client import ToolGateClient, ToolGateConfig, ToolGateError
from agent_builder_agent.core.github_facts import (
    GitHubFacts,
    format_github_facts_section,
    summarize_ci_failures,
    summarize_open_prs,
)
from agent_builder_agent.router.llm_router_client import LLMRouterClient, LLMRouterConfig, LLMRouterError
from agent_builder_agent.schemas.agent_builder_request_v0 import AgentBuilderRequestV0
from agent_builder_agent.tools.github_read_client import GitHubReadClient, GitHubReadConfig, GitHubReadError


def build_agent() -> Agent:
    return Agent(
        name="AgentBuilderAgentV1_1",
        instructions=(
            "You are AgentBuilderAgent v1.1. You only produce PullRequestProposal(JSON) "
            "or AgentBuilderError(JSON). You do not perform git/infra/secret operations. "
            "Tool execution requires ToolGate allow; write tools are not used in v1.1."
        ),
        tools=[],
    )


ParseSpecFn = Callable[[str, Optional[str], Optional[dict[str, Any]]], dict[str, Any]]
NormalizeSpecFn = Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any]
InferStepsFn = Callable[..., Awaitable[list[str]]]
GenerateSkeletonFn = Callable[..., Awaitable[Any]]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AgentDeps:
    """DI seam for testing.

    Defaults preserve production behavior.
    """

    parse_spec: ParseSpecFn = _parse_spec
    normalize_spec: NormalizeSpecFn = _normalize_spec
    infer_steps_if_missing: InferStepsFn = _infer_steps_if_missing
    generate_skeleton: GenerateSkeletonFn = _generate_skeleton


class AgentBuilderAgentV1_1:
    def __init__(
        self,
        router: LLMRouterClient,
        toolgate: ToolGateClient,
        github: GitHubReadClient,
        deps: Optional[AgentDeps] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._router = router
        self._toolgate = toolgate
        self._github = github
        self._deps = deps or AgentDeps()

    @staticmethod
    def _router_from_env() -> LLMRouterClient:
        base_url = os.environ.get("LLM_ROUTER_URL", "").strip()
        if not base_url:
            raise RuntimeError("LLM_ROUTER_URL is required.")
        api_key = os.environ.get("LLM_ROUTER_API_KEY")
        return LLMRouterClient(LLMRouterConfig(base_url=base_url, api_key=api_key))

    @staticmethod
    def _toolgate_from_env() -> ToolGateClient:
        base_url = os.environ.get("TOOLGATE_URL", "").strip()
        if not base_url:
            raise RuntimeError("TOOLGATE_URL is required for tool permission checks.")
        api_key = os.environ.get("TOOLGATE_API_KEY")
        return ToolGateClient(ToolGateConfig(base_url=base_url, api_key=api_key))

    @staticmethod
    def _github_from_env() -> GitHubReadClient:
        token = os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN")
        base_url = os.environ.get("GITHUB_API_BASE_URL", "https://api.github.com")
        return GitHubReadClient(GitHubReadConfig(base_url=base_url, token=token))

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls) -> "AgentBuilderAgentV1_1":
        return cls(
            router=cls._router_from_env(),
            toolgate=cls._toolgate_from_env(),
            github=cls._github_from_env(),
            deps=None,
        )

    async def _maybe_github_facts(
        self,
        req: AgentBuilderRequestV0,
        name_hint: str,
        risk_level: str,
        high_risk_detected: bool,
    ) -> tuple[list[str], list[str], str]:
        decision_line = "github_read:not-requested"

        if req.githubReadMode == "off" or req.github is None:
            return [], [], decision_line

        try:
            d = await self._toolgate.evaluate(
                policy_version=req.toolPolicyVersion or "toolgate_v1",
                request_id=req.requestId,
                proposal_id=None,
                tool="github_read",
                effect="read",
                context={
                    "humanApproved": False,
                    "riskLevel": risk_level,
                    "highRiskDetected": bool(high_risk_detected),
                    "pathsTouched": [],
                    "filesTouchedCount": 0,
                    "domains": ["agent"],
                },
            )
            decision_line = f"github_read:{d.decision}:{d.reason}"
        except (ToolGateError, Exception) as e:
            decision_line = f"github_read:deny:toolgate_error:{e}"
            return ["GitHub Facts:", "- github_read: deny (toolgate_error)"], [], decision_line

        if d.decision != "allow":
            return ["GitHub Facts:", f"- github_read: deny {d.reason}"], [], decision_line

        repo = req.github.repo
        base_ref = req.github.baseRef or req.repoContext.baseBranch

        notes: list[str] = []
        manual: list[str] = []

        overlap: list[str] = []
        failures: list[str] = []

        try:
            prs = await self._github.list_open_prs(repo)
            overlap = summarize_open_prs(prs, name_hint=name_hint)
        except GitHubReadError as e:
            notes.append(f"Failed to list open PRs: {e}")

        if req.githubReadMode == "metadata+ci":
            try:
                runs = await self._github.list_check_runs(repo, ref=base_ref)
                failures = summarize_ci_failures(runs)
                if failures:
                    manual.append("Reproduce or confirm recent CI failures before applying this proposal.")
            except GitHubReadError as e:
                notes.append(f"Failed to read check-runs: {e}")

        if overlap:
            manual.append("Potential overlap PR(s) detected; confirm consolidation/duplication strategy.")

        section = format_github_facts_section(GitHubFacts(overlap_prs=overlap, ci_failures=failures, notes=notes))
        return section.splitlines(), manual, decision_line

    async def build_proposal(self, request_json: dict) -> dict:
        request_id = str(request_json.get("requestId", "unknown"))
        try:
            req = AgentBuilderRequestV0.model_validate(request_json)
        except Exception as e:
            return error_response(
                request_id=request_id,
                code="SPEC_VALIDATION_FAILED",
                message="Request validation failed.",
                details=[str(e)],
            )

        if req.validationMode != "none":
            r = schema_validate_request_v0(request_json)
            if not r.ok:
                return error_response(
                    request_id=req.requestId,
                    code="SPEC_VALIDATION_FAILED",
                    message="Schema validation failed for AgentBuilderRequestV0.",
                    details=r.errors,
                )

        spec_text, spec_obj = req.get_spec_payload()
        try:
            raw = self._deps.parse_spec(req.specFormat, spec_text, spec_obj)
            parsed = self._deps.normalize_spec(raw)
        except SpecParseError as e:
            return error_response(
                request_id=req.requestId,
                code="SPEC_PARSE_FAILED",
                message="Failed to parse spec.",
                details=[str(e)],
            )

        risk = detect_high_risk(parsed.raw)
        risk_level = "high" if risk.high_risk_detected else "low"

        snapshot = snapshot_from_existing_tree(req.repoContext.existingTree)
        hints = derive_structure_hints(snapshot)

        gh_lines: list[str] = []
        gh_manual: list[str] = []
        gh_decision_line = "github_read:not-requested"
        try:
            gh_lines, gh_manual, gh_decision_line = await self._maybe_github_facts(
                req,
                name_hint=parsed.name,
                risk_level=risk_level,
                high_risk_detected=risk.high_risk_detected,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            gh_lines = ["GitHub Facts:", f"- github_read: unavailable ({e})"]
            gh_manual = []
            gh_decision_line = f"github_read:deny:internal_error:{e}"

        try:
            steps = await self._deps.infer_steps_if_missing(
                router=self._router,
                routing_profile=req.routingProfile,
                name=parsed.name,
                purpose=parsed.purpose,
                raw_spec=parsed.raw,
                existing_steps=parsed.steps,
            )
        except (LLMRouterError, Exception):
            steps = ["Define project structure", "Generate core modules", "Add minimal README"]

        try:
            sk = await self._deps.generate_skeleton(
                router=self._router,
                routing_profile=req.routingProfile,
                target=req.target.model_dump(mode="json"),
                spec=parsed.raw,
                steps=steps,
                structure_hints=hints,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            return error_response(
                request_id=req.requestId,
                code="INTERNAL_ERROR",
                message="Failed to generate skeleton.",
                details=[str(e)],
            )

        title = f"Scaffold {parsed.name} skeleton (proposal-only, v1.1)"

        summary_lines = [
            f"Generates a minimal skeleton for '{parsed.name}' based on the provided spec.",
            "v1.1 adds GitHub read-only facts (ToolGate-gated) to improve proposal quality.",
            "Outputs are proposal-only; no git/infra/secret operations are performed.",
            "",
            f"Purpose: {parsed.purpose}",
            "",
            "ToolGate decisions:",
            f"- {gh_decision_line}",
        ]

        if gh_lines:
            summary_lines += ["", *gh_lines]

        if risk.high_risk_detected:
            summary_lines += [
                "",
                "High-risk signals detected: proposal continues, but high-risk files are omitted.",
            ]

        files = [(f.path, f.content_type, f.content) for f in sk.files]
        proposal = build_pull_request_proposal(
            request_id=req.requestId,
            router_profile=req.routingProfile,
            title=title,
            summary="\n".join(summary_lines),
            risk=risk,
            directories=sk.directories,
            files=files,
            dependencies=[],
        )

        if gh_manual:
            try:
                proposal.validation.manualSteps.extend(gh_manual)
            except Exception:
                pass

        out = proposal.model_dump(mode="json")

        if req.validationMode != "none":
            pv = schema_validate_proposal_v0(out)
            if not pv.ok:
                return error_response(
                    request_id=req.requestId,
                    code="INTERNAL_ERROR",
                    message="Schema validation failed for PullRequestProposalV0.",
                    details=pv.errors,
                )

        return out

manualSteps: Run pytest; confirm integration tests no longer rely on monkeypatch and still perform no network calls.
Confirm AgentDeps defaults preserve production behavior (no runtime change when deps is omitted).
